  • Constructor Details

    • ConstraintSummaryEntry

      private ConstraintSummaryEntry(int rank, ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.ConstraintSummaryEntry.Classification classification, ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.LeadingConstraintEvidence.Source source, String qualifiedConstraintName, double applicableLimit, String physicalUnit, String applicableLimitRole, String applicableLimitProvenance, List<List<String>> sliceAxes, int sampledPointCount, int feasibleBoundaryCount, int infeasibleBoundaryCount, int feasibleEvidenceCount, int rejectingEvidenceCount, double minimumNormalizedMargin, ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.LeadingConstraintEvidence representativeFeasibleConstraint, ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.LeadingConstraintEvidence representativeRejectingConstraint)
      Creates one immutable ranked aggregate.
      Parameters:
      rank - one-based deterministic rank
      classification - rejecting or feasible near-active classification
      source - evidence layer
      qualifiedConstraintName - stable constraint identity
      applicableLimit - exact physical limit
      physicalUnit - physical engineering unit
      applicableLimitRole - engineering role of the limit
      applicableLimitProvenance - provenance of the limit
      sliceAxes - ordered axes where this identity was observed
      sampledPointCount - sampled-point occurrence count
      feasibleBoundaryCount - final feasible-endpoint occurrence count
      infeasibleBoundaryCount - final infeasible-endpoint occurrence count
      feasibleEvidenceCount - exact feasible-row count
      rejectingEvidenceCount - exact rejecting-row count
      minimumNormalizedMargin - minimum finite feasible normalized margin
      representativeFeasibleConstraint - representative exact feasible row
      representativeRejectingConstraint - representative exact rejecting row
